region_label: Inland — Crystal Springs, Dade City, Lakeland, Ocala
notes: Method: Airbnb blocks WebFetch but answers curl with a browser user-agent, so every property here was pulled from DATED Airbnb searches for 19–27 Dec 2026, 9 adults, min_bedrooms=5, max_bedrooms=6 — the embedded data-deferred-state JSON gives real 8-night totals, coordinates and images for the actual dates. Ran named-place searches on Dade City, Zephyrhills, Plant City, Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Odessa, Lutz, Lithia, Valrico, Thonotosassa, San Antonio, Lakeland, Winter Haven, Lake Wales, Ocala, Brooksville, Inverness and Floral City, then paginated map-bounded searches (7 pages x 18 results) over three boxes — Pasco/east Hillsborough, Polk lake country and Marion — plus tight zoom-11 boxes to make sure nothing local was buried under Tampa sprawl. 125 unique listings in the wide pass, 53 in the tight boxes, and every one of them returned a live price for the dates, so all properties below are recorded as search_listed with the quoted total. Individual Airbnb listing pages also fetch fine via curl; their roomTourItems JSON gives exact per-room bed sizes, which is where the king counts below come from. CRYSTAL SPRINGS: confirmed again — no nightly rentals of its own; platform pages re-serve Zephyrhills and Dade City. DADE CITY / ZEPHYRHILLS AT 5–6 BEDROOMS: the tight Pasco box (28.05–28.55 N, 81.95–82.45 W) returns only eleven 5–6BR houses for these dates in the entire county, and just two are actually in Dade City — the 6BR one-acre estate at $6,126 and the 5BR Lakeview Estate at $9,307 (also Vrbo 3930873). Zephyrhills has exactly one: a brand-new 5BR with a pool at $3,000, four miles from Crystal Springs and the closest bookable house to the hamlet. So the answer to 'does dropping from 6–8BR to 5–6BR unlock Dade City / Zephyrhills stock?' is: barely — it adds the Zephyrhills new-build and the Dade City Lakeview Estate, and that is all. Real 5–6BR inventory with character sits further out, in Wesley Chapel/Lutz, Polk lake country and Marion horse country. BLOCKED: HiChee (hichee.com) 301-redirects every request and returned nothing usable this pass. Vrbo search pages 403 as expected, though individual Vrbo listing pages fetch fine and were used to cross-check the Dade City Lakeview Estate. One promising find from web search — 'Beautiful Lakeview Saltwater Pool Sanctuary', Dade City, 10+ acres with a fireplace, saltwater pool, heated jacuzzi and a baby grand piano — turns out to be a dead Airbnb listing (room 645677980859526653 returns 404), so it appears to be off-market and is not included. EXCLUDED: Davenport / Haines City / Champions Gate Disney-corridor villas (a different trip), and Tampa-city, Apollo Beach, Palm Harbor, Hernando Beach and Crystal River coastal stock belonging to other regions. Also excluded several 5–6BR houses whose capacity leaned on bunk rooms or 10–15 beds — e.g. a Plant City 6BR with 13 beds, an Ocala 6BR with 15 beds, a Belleview 5BR with 13 beds, and a Wesley Chapel farmhouse whose five bedrooms are three bunk beds and two queens. HEATED POOLS ARE SCARCE INLAND: of everything checked, only the Ocala WEC show home states a year-round heated private pool in its amenity data. Most inland pools are unheated screened or saltwater pools, which in late December will be cold. If a heated pool is non-negotiable, that Ocala house is the one; otherwise prioritise the fireplace-and-hot-tub houses.

properties.beds_note: 7 beds across 6 bedrooms; host states 'high-end king or queen mattresses' but does not itemise which rooms are king. Worth a message to the host before booking to confirm three kings. Airbnb does not publish a guest cap on this listing; 6 bedrooms / 7 beds. Confirm with the host.
properties.price_note: Airbnb quoted $6,126 total for 19–27 Dec 2026, discounted from $6,508.

KitchenAid gas stove and double oven
properties.why: The largest and closest true estate to Crystal Springs at this size — 5,000 sq ft on a walled acre in Dade City, with a pool and a proper outdoor kitchen, and only six bedrooms so nobody is sleeping in a dorm.

properties.name: Saddlebrook 6BR with wood-burning fireplace and private hot tub
properties.neighborhood: Saddlebrook Resort, ~14 mi south-west of Crystal Springs
properties.beds_note: Host states BR1–BR3 and BR5–BR6 can each be set as one king OR two twins; BR4 is a fixed queen; two dens each hold a twin. The king setup is two twin frames pushed together under a king mattress topper. You can order exactly three kings and leave the rest as twins.
properties.price_note: Airbnb quoted $8,612 total for 19–27 Dec 2026, discounted from $9,638. Note: an identical duplicate listing (Airbnb 750141085187200449) quotes the same $8,612.
properties.why: The only house in the region that lets you dial the bed configuration to order — five of the six rooms convert between king and twins, so you can book exactly three kings for the couples and twins for the three adult children, with a wood-burning fireplace and a private hot tub for December.
properties.cons: Expensive for what it is, and there is no private pool — you are relying on Saddlebrook's resort facilities. The 'king' is two twin frames joined, which some people notice. It is a resort villa, not a country house.
properties.drive_note: ~35 min to Tampa International; ~1 hr to the Gulf beaches.
properties.availability_note: Returned by an Airbnb search dated 19–27 Dec 2026 for 9 adults with a quoted total of $8,612 for 8 nights.
